# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.2.11 for Windows

- Automatically selects CUDA on compatible NVIDIA GPUs with 8 GB or more, including the 11 GB RTX 2080 Ti, when enough GPU memory is available.
- Improves validation of prepared stems during reuse and repacking.
- Makes explicit regeneration available for tracks with outdated or incomplete existing stems.
